plan.title: TASK-376 close-out, as the request stated it

steps.title: Parse cache keyed by content hash
steps.task: Bring `src/incremental/cache.ts` to a state where a parse result is stored under the SHA-256 of the file's bytes, so a file whose content returns to an earlier state is served from the cache rather than re-parsed.

steps.title: Edit ranges from the watcher
steps.task: Bring `src/incremental/ranges.ts` to a state where a watcher event becomes the byte ranges that changed, merged where they overlap and ordered by start offset.

steps.title: Symbol table diffing
steps.task: Bring `src/incremental/diff.ts` to a state where two symbol tables produce the added, removed and moved symbols between them, with a moved symbol reported once rather than as a removal and an addition.

steps.title: Watcher debounce
steps.task: Bring `src/watch/debounce.ts` to a state where a burst of events for one file collapses into a single event carrying the last state, and events for different files are never collapsed together.

steps.title: Re-index only the ranges that moved
steps.task: Bring `src/incremental/reindex.ts` to a state where the index is rebuilt for the edit ranges alone, leaving every symbol outside them untouched and their references intact.

deps.evidence: By then TASK-376.21 has landed, and these two touch different files.

steps.title: Index metrics
steps.task: Bring `src/metrics/index.ts` to a state where every index build records how many files it read, how many it parsed and how long each phase took.

deps.evidence: By then TASK-376.21 has landed, and these two touch different files.

steps.title: Incremental re-parse
steps.task: Bring `docs/measurements/incremental.md` to a state where it records the measured cost of a one-file re-parse against a whole-project parse, taken on this repository, and the acceptance criteria TASK-376 still leaves open are ticked.
